text_block_list.text:
One day after training.
With curfew fast approaching, I walked
Biwa Hayahide back to her dorm, when—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Hayahide!
It's rare for you to come back at this hour.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"I got a little too carried away with training—
Are you doing your dorm head duties? It must be tough working so late..."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That's not true. Greeting the little ponies after all their hard work is always fun for me anyway.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, by the way... Did you happen to see
Sweep and Marvelous on your way here?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I tried reaching out to her on her phone, but got no reply. She's one of the younger girls in the dorm, so I'm worried.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we'd better hurry and search for it...
I'll help too!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you, both of you...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let's split into two groups then. You two look for Hayahide and the others!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
Is there any info that might serve as a clue to their destination?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Apparently Marvelous went out on a "marvelous hunt☆,"
while Sweep went looking for "magic ingredients," but—
choice_data_list: Let's look for a Sweep who can help narrow down the destination.
Let's search for Marvelous things that could be in a lot of places.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to things that could serve as magic ingredients,
the possibilities are rather limited, after all."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's find her quickly
and join up with Fuji-kun.

Just in case we crossed paths, I left a note on the dorm door saying,
"Call the Dorm Head's cell once you return," and began my search.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"No good... Not this one.
But that one over there is the wrong color..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Found you, Sweep!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaaaaah!? Wh-Why are Hayahide-san
and the others at my gathering spot!?"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Fuji-kun asked me to look for you.
choice_data_list: Curfew's coming up soon, so let's head back.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"No way!
Is it really that time already!?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
B-But no! I am de-fi-nite-ly not going home
until I find the medicinal herbs for the ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...There must be a reason behind this, right?
Won't you talk to us?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sweep isn't the kind of magical girl
who would break the rules for no good reason.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uggghhh... That's right.
Yesterday, Grandma came down with a fever and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Her fever hasn't gone down today either.
So, I want to use magic to help her feel all better!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
However, if you don't return past curfew,
Fuji-kun and everyone at the dorm will worry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Grandma might get notified as well.
That isn't what you want, is it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh, of course!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In that case, would you let us
help you look for the medicinal herbs?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If we analyze the information you gave me
and narrow down the candidates, we should find it in no time.
choice_data_list: Let's find everyone quickly so we don't miss curfew!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...A-All right, fine.

And—
thanks to Biwa Hayahide, we were able to find
the plant we were looking for much faster than expected.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm so glad both Sweep
and Marvelous were found safe and sound."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
W-Well, you were a big help today.
...See you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My, what kind of magic did you use
to make her act so meek and mild?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Nothing at all.
I was just poking my nose into your business.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Seeing her reminded me of my younger sister,
and I just couldn't leave her alone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see. That "meddling" of yours
has saved both me and everyone in the dorm, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"It was the same today.
Let me thank you once again, Hayahide."

Perhaps surprised by Fuji Kiseki's words,
Biwa Hayahide looked
a little embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
With more people on our side, we ought to take charge of that.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
First, let's track down every spot on the grounds
that might be linked to the word 'Marvelous.'

Just in case we crossed paths, I left a note on the dorm door saying,
"Call the Dorm Head's cell once you return," and began my search.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Not on stage, huh......

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She's not in front of the Three Goddesses statue either...
Does that mean she's indoors?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A marvelous place in the school building, huh...
Maybe around the music room?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yet with no one here right now,
she shouldn't be feeling inspired by anyone—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Red and gorgeous, so marvelous☆
Super sparkly, marvelouuus★

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Marvelous...?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it's Hayahide!
What're you doing in a place like this~?☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*...
That's my line.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: "I heard it was a 'Marvelous Hunt,' but what on earth were you actually doing?"

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, there's this marvelous rumor that if you run through the school building at night,
a red light will chase after you—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: "When I tried running, a red light really came chasing after me, so I had a blast~☆"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
G-G-G-Ghosts are entirely illogical!
There is no way such things could possibly exist in this world!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If by some remote chance it does exist,
how should I deal with it—
Heeey... Heeey...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh!
A red light~☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~☆
Hayahide, that was crazy fast~★
choice_data_list: Or rather, the red light's true identity is...

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry,
looks like I scared you a bit.

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text: Curfew's coming up soon for you guys too, so hurry on home, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, you two...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Frenzied as I was,
I committed the sheer folly of fleeing on my own."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Right, right. In the end,
both Marvelous and Sweep made it back safely anyway.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, being bad with ghosts is
quite a cute weakness for you, Hayahide."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Guh...!
Well, what else could I have done?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Its ecology is unknown, and past cases are completely unreliable!
How are we supposed to deal with this?!
choice_data_list: I was a security guard this time, so I'm fine!
I was a security guard this time, so it's okay!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah, you're right...
Thanks to that, I think I can sleep peacefully tonight...

Biwa Hayahide let out a sigh as she said that,
looking thoroughly relieved from the bottom of her heart.
